patch:
--- a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_expression_parser.brp
+++ b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_expression_parser.brp
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 -- Direct post-order parsing. Unsupported input returns the saved persistent
 -- entry; rejected expressions retain diagnostics but discard trial ids.
 import:
+	dict: dict, get, set
 	../lex/lexed_module: LiteralValue(IntegerValue, FloatValue, TextValue), HoleScan, ScannedPiece(ScannedText, ScannedHole)
 	../syntax/expressions:
 		Expression, Hole, SubscriptPlace, Body(BlockBody), ExpressionKind(If, Match, Select, Lambda, NameReference, IntegerLiteral, FloatLiteral, StringLiteral, InterpolatedString, BooleanLiteral, CharacterLiteral, VoidValue, Unary, Binary, ShortCircuit, RangeExpression, Call, FieldAccess, Subscript, ListLiteral, TupleLiteral, VectorLiteral, RecordLiteral, RecordUpdate, DictLiteral, Detach, OpaqueConversion, CompilerBuiltin),
@@ -13,9 +14,8 @@
 	-- Expressions and bodies call each other for controls and lambdas;
 	-- their completed recursive syntax types belong to syntax/expressions.
 	tree_body_parser: BodyContext(OutsideLoop, InsideLoop), LambdaParse(ParsedLambda, UnsupportedLambda), parse_lambda, parse_control
-	../syntax/ids: spelling_index
+	../syntax/ids: SpellingId
 	../syntax/sequences: AtLeastOne, SmallTuple(Pair, Triple, Quadruple), at_least_one_items
-	../syntax/names: WrittenName
 	../syntax/diagnostics: SyntaxDiagnostic(Plain, DuplicateFieldGiven)
 	../syntax/patterns: StringForm(QuotedString, RawString, PipeString, RawPipeString)
 	../tables/diagnostic_code: PlainSyntaxCode(ExpectedExpressionDiagnostic, SingletonTupleDiagnostic, TupleArityDiagnostic, ExpectedBuiltinNameDiagnostic)
@@ -1123,30 +1123,20 @@
 -- pointing at the first field of that name.
 private pure func reported_repeated_fields(state: ParseState, fields: AtLeastOne[NamedValue]) -> (ParseState, FieldList):
 	var out = state
-	var seen: List[NamedValue] = []
+	-- The module interner gives equal written names the same spelling id.
+	var first_span_by_spelling: Dict[SpellingId, Span] = dict()
 	var repeated = False
 	for field in at_least_one_items(fields):
-		match seen.first_named(field.name.name):
+		match first_span_by_spelling.get(field.name.name.spelling):
 			Some(earlier):
-				out = out.report_diagnostic(field.name.name.span, DuplicateFieldGiven(earlier.name.name.span))
+				out = out.report_diagnostic(field.name.name.span, DuplicateFieldGiven(earlier))
 				repeated = True
 			None:
-				void
-		seen = seen.append(field)
+				first_span_by_spelling = first_span_by_spelling.set(field.name.name.spelling, field.name.name.span)
 	if repeated:
 		(out, RepeatedFields)
 	else:
 		(out, DistinctFields(fields))
-
-
--- Spellings are per module, and a parse covers one module, so the spelling
--- index identifies a name.
-private pure func first_named(fields: List[NamedValue], name: WrittenName) -> Option[NamedValue]:
-	var first: Option[NamedValue] = None
-	for field in fields:
-		if first.is_none() and spelling_index(field.name.name.spelling) == spelling_index(name.spelling):
-			first = Some(field)
-	first
 
 
 private pure func field_item(state: ParseState, loop_context: BodyContext) -> (ParseState, ItemsParse[NamedValue]):
--- a/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_record_fields_parser.brp
+++ b/blorp/src/compiler_new/stage_01_discovery/parse/tree_record_fields_parser.brp
@@ -1,8 +1,9 @@
 -- Shared braced field lists for written ordinary and fixed record declarations.
 import:
+	dict: dict, get, set
 	../syntax/declarations: FieldDeclaration
 	../syntax/diagnostics: SyntaxDiagnostic(DuplicateField)
-	../syntax/spellings: spelling_text
+	../syntax/ids: SpellingId, DefinitionId
 	../tables/expected_token:
 		NameConstruct(NameInFieldName),
 		ExpectedTokenDiagnostic(ExpectedLeftBrace, ExpectedRightBrace, ExpectedColon),
@@ -13,7 +14,7 @@
 	../tables/token: TokenKind(LeftBraceSymbol, RightBraceSymbol, ColonSymbol, CommaSymbol, EndOfFileToken)
 	parse_state:
 		ParseState, current_kind, current_span, advanced,
-		diagnostic_count, consume_ordinary_name, consume_declared_name, expect_token, report_diagnostic, spellings,
+		diagnostic_count, consume_ordinary_name, consume_declared_name, expect_token, report_diagnostic,
 		finished_field,
 	tree_type_parser: parse_type
 
@@ -50,6 +51,8 @@
 private pure func parse_fields_contents(state: ParseState, before: Int, closing: RightBraceConstruct) -> (ParseState, RecordFieldsParse):
 	var out: ParseState = state
 	var fields: List[FieldDeclaration] = []
+	-- The module interner identifies each name; keep its first completed field.
+	var first_field_by_spelling: Dict[SpellingId, DefinitionId] = dict()
 	var parsing: Bool = out.current_kind() != RightBraceSymbol
 
 	while parsing and out.current_kind() != EndOfFileToken:
@@ -61,17 +64,19 @@
 			None:
 				void
 			Some(field_name):
-				-- Compare written spellings. Search only this
-				-- declaration, before appending the repeated field itself.
 				-- Report after its type to preserve diagnostic ordering.
-				for earlier in fields:
-					if out.spellings().spelling_text(earlier.name.spelling) == out.spellings().spelling_text(field_name.spelling):
-						out = out.report_diagnostic(field_name.span, DuplicateField(earlier.id))
-						break
+				first = first_field_by_spelling.get(field_name.spelling)
+				match first:
+					Some(earlier):
+						out = out.report_diagnostic(field_name.span, DuplicateField(earlier))
+					None:
+						void
 
 				(after_field, field) = out.finished_field(field_name, field_type, field_name.span.span_covering(field_type.span))
 				out = after_field
 				fields = fields.append(field)
+				if first.is_none():
+					first_field_by_spelling = first_field_by_spelling.set(field_name.spelling, field.id)
 
 		if out.current_kind() == CommaSymbol:
 			out = out.advanced()
